origins.description: A deep, reinforced civil defense installation designed for continuity of government.
origins.flavor_text: Heavy blast doors and thick lead-lined concrete offer superior protection against fallout, though tight quarters test survivor patience.

origins.description: An expansive industrial extraction complex cut deep into bedrock.
origins.flavor_text: Vast hollows and drill tracks provide boundless space for expansion, but stagnant air requires constant mechanical scrubbers.

origins.description: A repurposed reinforced public school basement where communal solidarity and youth care run high.
origins.flavor_text: Chalkboards, cots, and book crates foster an ethos of collective duty and mutual care, though exterior brickwork is fragile.

origins.description: A luxury pre-war redoubt engineered with high-grade components and pristine automated comforts.
origins.flavor_text: Finely engineered filtration and brass fittings ensure luxury, though limited square meters forbid large cohorts.

origins.description: A hastily fortified underground root cellar bolstered by salvaged corrugated sheeting and earth embankments.
origins.flavor_text: Built on grit and scavenged scrap, rapid access lets scavengers deploy swiftly, but storms leak moisture and bitter frost.

origins.description: A decommissioned perimeter outpost built for defensive containment and munitions storage.
origins.flavor_text: Stout firing slits and reinforced perimeter emplacements repel raiders, but clinical supplies are nonexistent.
